headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 24, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 27.42%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.18%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 14.24%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the broader market's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 49.86%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.13%, showing that even the lower performers are above the benchmark. This relative strength is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
